source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 20 exercise solved (PDF 166-168): MCQ keys, model answers and step-by-step numericals; all four printed numerical answers checked and agree.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Medical Physics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur numerical problems ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Choose the correct answer. (Sahi jawab chunein.)

blocks.prompt:
20.1 What kind of radiation is detected in a PET scan after positron annihilation?
(PET scan mein positron annihilation ke baad kis qisam ki radiation detect hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tracer ka positron ek electron se milta hai aur dono annihilate (khatam) ho jate hain; un ka mass do gamma-ray photons mein badal jata hai jo ulti simton mein jate hain. Yahi photons detectors ki ring detect karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.2 What is the role of coincidence detection in PET-scanning?
(PET-scanning mein coincidence detection (ek waqt mein pakarna) ka kya kirdar hai?)

options.text: To control the temperature of the scanner
To detect gamma rays arriving simultaneously

blocks.explanation: Ek annihilation ke do gamma photons ulti simton mein ja kar aamne saamne ke detectors tak taqreeban ek hi waqt pohanchte hain. Inhein ek saath (coincidence mein) pakarne se pata chalta hai ke dono ek hi event se aaye aur event in do detectors ko milane wali line par hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.3 Which principle allows ultrasound transducers to emit and detect sound waves?
(Kaun sa usool ultrasound transducer ko sound waves bhejne aur pakarne ke qabil banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alternating voltage piezoelectric crystal ko thartharata (vibrate karta) hai aur ultrasound nikalti hai (converse piezoelectric effect); wapas aane wali echoes crystal ko dabati hain aur voltage banta hai (direct piezoelectric effect).

blocks.prompt:
20.4 Which body part is commonly examined using ultrasound imaging?
(Ultrasound imaging se jism ka kaun sa hissa aam taur par dekha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ultrasound naram tissues (soft tissues) ki achhi tasweer deti hai. Abdomen (pet) mein liver, kidneys, gallbladder, pancreas aur bladder dekhe jate hain. Haddi taqreeban saari ultrasound wapas laut deti hai, is liye skull, bones aur teeth is tarah nahin dekhe jate.

blocks.prompt:
20.5 In X-ray imaging, what does "contrast" mainly depend on?
(X-ray imaging mein "contrast" zyada tar kis cheez par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Contrast tissues ki roshni (brightness) ka farq hai. Yeh X-rays ke mukhtalif jazb hone (attenuation) se aata hai, I = I₀e^(−μx), jo tissue ki density (ghanapan) aur thickness (motaai) x par munhasir hai (aur X-ray energy par bhi).

blocks.prompt:
20.6 What advantage does a CT scan have over a standard X-ray image?
(Aam X-ray image ke muqable mein CT scan ka kya faida hai?)

options.text: Uses sound waves instead of X-rays

blocks.explanation: CT scanner jism ke ek hisse ki X-ray tasweerein bohat se zaviyon (angles) se leta hai; computer un se cross-sectional (2D) slices banata hai aur unhein jor kar 3D image banata hai. CT mein radiation zyada, machine mushkil aur X-rays hi istemal hoti hain.

blocks.prompt:
20.7 What kind of wave is used in ultrasound imaging?
(Ultrasound imaging mein kis qisam ki wave istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ultrasound zyada frequency (1 MHz-15 MHz) wali sound wave hai. Sound tissues mein longitudinal (lambai ke rukh dabao wali) wave ki tarah chalti hai; yeh mechanical wave hai, electromagnetic nahin, aur non-ionizing hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.8 Characteristic X-rays are produced due to:
(Characteristic X-rays kis wajah se paida hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tez electron heavy target atom ke andar wale (K ya L) shell ka electron nikaal deta hai; oopar wale shell ka electron is khali jagah (hole) ko bharta hai aur X-ray photon nikalta hai, maslan hf(Kα) = E_L − E_K. In ki energy target ke material par munhasir hai, is liye 'characteristic'.

blocks.prompt:
20.9 What does CT stand for in medical imaging?
(Medical imaging mein CT ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: CT = Computed Tomography: 'computed' kyunke computer data process karta hai, 'tomography' Greek lafz tomos (slice, tukra) se.

blocks.prompt:
20.1 Which type of radiation is produced during a PET scan?
PET scan ke dauran kis qisam ki radiation paida hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Gamma rays. Tracer positrons nikalta hai; har positron tissue ke ek electron se mil kar annihilate hota hai aur un ka mass do gamma-ray photons mein badal jata hai jo ulti simton mein jate hain. Yehi gamma rays detector ring pakarti hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.2 Which physical effect enables ultrasound transducers to produce sound waves?
Kaun sa physical effect ultrasound transducer ko sound waves banane ke qabil banata hai?
blocks.explanation: Piezoelectric effect (converse shakal). Piezoelectric crystal (maslan quartz, PZT) par alternating voltage lagane se woh tezi se phailta aur sukarta hai, yani vibrate karta hai aur ultrasound waves nikalti hain. Wapas aane wali echoes is mein voltage paida karti hain (direct effect).

blocks.prompt:
20.3 Mention one area of the body commonly examined using ultrasound.
Jism ka koi ek hissa batayein jo aam taur par ultrasound se dekha jata hai.
blocks.explanation: Abdomen (pet): liver, kidneys, gallbladder, pancreas aur bladder. Is ke ilawa pregnancy mein bachay (fetus) ki growth aur dil (echocardiography) bhi ultrasound se dekhe jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
20.4 What causes contrast in X-ray images of different body tissues?
Jism ke mukhtalif tissues ki X-ray images mein contrast ki wajah kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif tissues X-rays ko mukhtalif miqdar mein jazb (attenuate) karte hain, I = I₀e^(−μx); μ tissue ki density, atomic number aur X-ray energy par munhasir hai. Haddi zyada jazb karti hai is liye safaid dikhti hai; soft tissue aur hawa kam jazb karte hain is liye grey ya kaali dikhte hain.

blocks.prompt:
20.5 State one major difference between a CT scan and a standard X-ray image.
CT scan aur aam X-ray image mein ek bara farq bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Aam X-ray ek flat 2D tasweer deta hai jis mein haddiyan aur aaza (organs) ek doosre ke oopar aa jate hain, jabke CT scan cross-sectional slices bana kar 3D image deta hai, is liye har cheez alag aur apni sahi jagah par nazar aati hai.

rows: Cross-sectional slices aur 3D image
Sirf ek flat 2D tasweer
Organs ek doosre ke oopar nahin aate
Aagay aur peechay ki cheezein ek doosre par aa jati hain

blocks.prompt:
20.6 What occurs when ultrasound hits the boundary between two tissues?
Jab ultrasound do tissues ki boundary (sarhad) se takrati hai to kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Wave ka kuch hissa echo (goonj) ban kar wapas laut aata hai aur baqi agle tissue mein chala jata hai. Dono tissues ki acoustic impedance (sound ki rukawat) mein jitna zyada farq ho, echo utni taqatwar hoti hai; transducer yehi echo pakar kar tasweer banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.7 What does the abbreviation "CT" stand for, and how does it improve imaging?
"CT" kis ka mukhtasar hai, aur yeh imaging ko kaise behtar banata hai?
blocks.explanation: CT ka matlab Computed Tomography hai. X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai aur bohat se zaviyon se tasweerein leti hai; computer un se slices bana kar 3D image banata hai. Is se organs ek doosre ke oopar nahin aate aur organs aur tumour ka size, shakal aur sahi jagah nazar aati hai, chahe tissues ki density mili julti ho.

blocks.prompt:
20.8 What do you know about the terms kα, kβ, kₚ, X-rays.
Kα, Kβ aur Kγ X-rays ke baare mein aap kya jante hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh characteristic X-rays hain jo heavy target atom ke K-shell ki khali jagah (vacancy) bharne par nikalti hain. Kα: electron L-shell se K-shell mein aata hai, hf = E_L − E_K. Kβ: M-shell se K-shell mein, hf = E_M − E_K (Kα se zyada energy). Agli line, N-shell se K-shell mein (hf = E_N − E_K), Kγ hai. In ki energy target ke material par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "kα, kβ, kₚ" chhapa hai. Yeh K-series ki lines Kα, Kβ aur Kγ hain (K-shell ke liye bara K); teesra lafz "kₚ" asal mein Kγ hai.
Constructed Response Questions (soch samajh kar jawab)

blocks.prompt:
20.1 What does a time difference in detecting gamma rays at two detectors indicate in a PET scan?
PET scan mein do detectors par gamma rays ke pakre jane ke waqt mein farq kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Ek annihilation ke do gamma photons ulti simton mein ek hi speed c se nikalte hain.
1. Agar dono aamne saamne ke detectors tak ek hi waqt pohanchein to annihilation detectors ko milane wali line ke bilkul darmiyan (midpoint) par hui.
2. Waqt ka chhota sa farq Δt batata hai ke event us detector ke qareeb tha jis ne pehle pakra; midpoint se faasla d = cΔt/2. Is (time-of-flight) maloomat se tracer ki jagah line par tay hoti hai aur tasweer saaf hoti hai.
3. Agar farq coincidence window (chand nanoseconds) se zyada ho to dono photons ek hi annihilation ke nahin, aur yeh jora radd (reject) kar diya jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho do dost ek hi waqt par ek jagah se ulti simton mein daurte hain. Jo pehle apni deewar tak pohancha, woh deewar shuru wali jagah ke qareeb thi. Isi tarah jis detector tak photon pehle pohancha, annihilation us ke qareeb hui. Light bohat tez hai (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹), is liye 1 nanosecond ka farq bhi taqreeban 15 cm ki jagah batata hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.2 Why is ultrasound not effective for imaging air-filled organs like the lungs?
Ultrasound hawa se bhare organs jaise lungs (phephron) ki tasweer ke liye kyun mufeed nahin?
blocks.explanation:
1. Echo un boundaries par banti hai jahan acoustic impedance (sound ki rukawat) mukhtalif ho. Hawa ki impedance soft tissue ke muqable mein bohat hi kam hai, is liye tissue aur hawa ki boundary par taqreeban saari ultrasound wapas laut jati hai aur lung ke andar bohat kam jati hai.
2. Jo thori si andar jati hai, woh lungs ki hawa mein jazb aur bikhar (scatter) jati hai.
3. Is liye lung ke andar se kaam ki echoes nahin aatin; sirf us ki satah par ek chamakdar line dikhti hai. (Isi wajah se probe aur skin ke darmiyan hawa hatane ke liye gel lagaya jata hai.) Lungs X-ray ya CT se dekhe jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
20.3 What happens when the X-ray contrast between two tissues is too low? Suggest a solution.
Jab do tissues ke darmiyan X-ray contrast bohat kam ho to kya hota hai? Hal tajweez karein.
blocks.explanation:
Jab do tissues X-rays ko taqreeban barabar jazb karein (mili julti density, atomic number aur thickness), to woh taqreeban ek jaise grey rang mein nazar aate hain. Un ki boundary nazar nahin aati aur bimari ya chot reh sakti hai (miss ho sakti hai).
Hal:
1. Zyada atomic number wala contrast medium istemal karein, jaise iodine (Z = 53, injection se) ya barium (Z = 56, barium meal pila kar). Yeh X-rays ko zyada jazb karta hai aur woh organ numayan ho jata hai.
2. Munasib X-ray energy chunein: soft tissues (jaise breast) ke liye soft (kam energy) X-rays, haddi ke liye hard X-rays.
3. CT scan karein, jo mili julti density wale tissues mein bhi farq dikha deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.4 How does CT scanning reduce the overlapping of organs seen in plain X-rays?
CT scanning saada X-ray mein nazar aane wale organs ke ek doosre par aa jane (overlapping) ko kaise kam karti hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Saada X-ray mein beam ke raaste ki saari cheezein ek hi flat 2D tasweer par aa jati hain, is liye ek doosre par chadh jati hain (maslan aagay aur peechay ki pasliyan).
2. CT mein X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai aur jism ke ek patle slice (tukre) mein se bohat se zaviyon se beam guzarti hai; saamne ke detectors har view record karte hain.
3. Computer in views ko jor kar sirf usi slice ki cross-sectional tasweer banata hai, is liye us se oopar ya neeche ke organs us par nahin aate.
4. Couch thora aagay khisakta hai aur agla slice liya jata hai; saare slices jor kar 3D image banti hai jis mein har organ apni jagah alag nazar aata hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.5 What could be a possible medical cause of uneven tracer concentration seen in a PET brain scan?
PET brain scan mein tracer ke ghair yaksaan (uneven) jama hone ki mumkina tibbi wajah kya ho sakti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Tracer zyada active tissues (jo zyada glucose istemal karein) mein zyada jama hota hai aur kam active mein kam, is liye uneven concentration ghair maamooli activity batati hai:
1. Chamakdar "hot spots" (zyada uptake): brain tumour, kyunke cancer cells bohat active hote hain aur zyada glucose lete hain; ya mirgi (epilepsy) ke daure ke waqt us ka markaz.
2. Kaale "cold spots" (kam uptake): woh hisse jahan activity ya khoon ki supply kam ho, maslan stroke ke baad, ya dementia jaise Alzheimer's disease mein.
(Normal dimagh mein bhi mukhtalif hisson ki activity thori mukhtalif hoti hai.)

blocks.prompt:
20.6 What is the purpose of lead collimators in PET gamma-ray detectors?
PET ke gamma-ray detectors mein lead collimators ka kya maqsad hai?

20.1 What is the piezoelectric effect, and how does it allow transducers to both emit and detect ultrasound waves?
Piezoelectric effect kya hai, aur yeh transducer ko ultrasound waves bhejne aur pakarne dono ke qabil kaise banata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Piezoelectric effect:
1. Yeh lafz Greek "piezein" (dabana) se hai. Yeh effect 1880 mein Pierre Curie aur Jacques Curie ne quartz, tourmaline aur Rochelle salt jaise crystals par daryaft kiya; aaj kal probes mein PZT (lead zirconate titanate) istemal hota hai.
2. In crystals ka koi centre of symmetry (tawazun ka markaz) nahin hota. In ke andar positive aur negative charges aam taur par barabar (balanced) hote hain.
3. Direct piezoelectric effect: jab crystal par mechanical pressure (dabao) dala jaye to charges thora khisak jate hain, tawazun bigarta hai aur satah par electric charge (voltage) ban jata hai. Dabao voltage mein badal jata hai.
4. Converse piezoelectric effect: jab crystal par electric field (voltage) lagaya jaye to us ki shakal thori badal jati hai. Voltage harkat (movement) mein badal jata hai.
Transducer bhejne aur pakarne wala:
1. Bhejna: crystal par ultrasonic frequency (1 MHz-15 MHz) ka alternating voltage lagaya jata hai. Converse effect se woh isi frequency par phailta aur sukarta hai, vibrate karta hai aur gel ke zariye jism mein ultrasound ki ek chhoti pulse bhejta hai.
2. Pakarna: phir transducer receive mode mein chala jata hai. Tissues ki boundaries se wapas aane wali echoes crystal se takra kar use dabati hain; direct effect se chhote voltages bante hain.
3. Yeh electrical signals computer mein jate hain jo un ke waqt ki deri (time delay) aur taqat se tasweer banata hai.
Yani ek hi crystal electrical energy ko sound mein aur sound ko wapas electrical signal mein badalta hai; isi dohre kirdar ki wajah se ek hi probe bhejta bhi hai aur pakarta bhi.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Aasan misaal: crystal ko dabao to bijli (voltage) banti hai; crystal ko bijli do to woh hilta hai. Ultrasound probe pehle bijli de kar crystal ko hilata hai (awaaz bhejta hai), phir chup ho kar sunta hai: wapas aane wali awaaz crystal ko dabati hai aur bijli ban jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.2 Describe how an ultrasound image is created using the concepts of echoes and reflected sound waves.
Bayan karein ke echoes aur reflected sound waves ki madad se ultrasound image kaise banti hai.
blocks.explanation:
Ultrasound imaging pulse-echo usool par kaam karti hai:
1. Transducer aur skin ke darmiyan gel lagaya jata hai taa ke hawa ka khala (air gap) khatam ho aur sound jism mein jaye.
2. Piezoelectric transducer zyada frequency (1 MHz-15 MHz) ki sound ki chhoti pulses jism mein bhejta hai. Waves tissues mein un ki qisam ke mutabiq mukhtalif speed se chalti hain.
3. Har us boundary par jahan do tissues ki acoustic impedance (jo tissue ki density aur us mein sound ki speed par munhasir hai) mukhtalif ho, wave ka kuch hissa echo ban kar laut aata hai; baqi aur gehrai mein ja kar agli boundaries se laut aata hai.
4. Transducer receive mode mein ja kar direct piezoelectric effect se echoes pakarta hai aur unhein electrical signals mein badalta hai.
5. Computer har echo ki waqt ki deri (time delay) t naapta hai. Sound boundary tak ja kar wapas aati hai, is liye gehrai d = vt/2 (soft tissue mein v taqreeban 1540 m s⁻¹). Maslan 100 µs baad aane wali echo d = (1540 m s⁻¹ × 100 × 10⁻⁶ s)/2 ≈ 7.7 cm gehrai se aati hai.
6. Echo ki taqat (intensity) roshni tay karti hai: taqatwar reflections (zyada impedance farq, maslan tissue aur haddi) zyada chamakdar dikhti hain.
7. Beam ko bohat si lines par ghuma kar computer real time mein organs ki 2D tasweer banata hai.
Tasweer ka maiyar: zyada impedance farq se boundaries saaf; zyada frequency se behtar resolution magar kam gehrai tak pohanch; gel se sound achhi tarah andar jati hai. Misaal: pregnancy mein amniotic fluid aur bachay (fetus) ki boundaries se aane wali echoes bachay ki tasweer dikhati hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yeh pahar mein awaaz dene jaisa hai: awaaz deewar se takra kar goonj (echo) ban kar wapas aati hai, aur jitni der se goonj aaye, deewar utni door hai. Ultrasound machine yehi kaam bohat tezi se hazaron baar karti hai aur har goonj ka waqt aur taqat dekh kar andar ki tasweer bana deti hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.3 Explain how the absorption (attenuation) of X-rays by different tissues creates contrast in the resulting image. Include an example.
Wazahat karein ke mukhtalif tissues ka X-rays ko jazb karna (attenuation) tasweer mein contrast kaise paida karta hai. Misaal bhi dein.
blocks.explanation:
Attenuation (kamzor hona):
1. Jab X-rays jism mein se guzarti hain to atoms se takrati hain (unhein ionize kar sakti hain), energy khoti hain aur kuch jazb ya scatter (bikhar) ho jati hain. Isay attenuation kehte hain.
2. Intensity thickness ke saath exponential tareeqe se kam hoti hai: I = I₀e^(−μx), jahan I₀ shuru ki intensity, I thickness x se guzarne ke baad ki intensity, aur μ attenuation coefficient hai jo material (us ki density aur atomic number) aur X-ray energy par munhasir hai.
Contrast:
1. Mukhtalif tissues ka μ aur thickness mukhtalif hai, is liye un mein se mukhtalif miqdar mein X-rays film ya detector tak pohanchti hain.
2. Haddi (ghani, calcium wali) ka μ bara hai aur woh zyada tar X-rays jazb kar leti hai: detector tak kam pohanchti hain aur haddi safaid dikhti hai.
3. Soft tissues (muscle, charbi, organs) kam jazb karte hain aur grey dikhte hain; lungs ki hawa bohat kam jazb karti hai aur kaali dikhti hai.
4. Guzarne wali intensity ka yehi farq, jis se tissues alag pehchane jate hain, contrast hai. Contrast X-ray energy par bhi munhasir hai: haddiyon ke liye hard X-rays, soft tissues (jaise breast) ke liye soft X-rays.
Misaal: chest X-ray mein pasliyan aur reerh ki haddi safaid, dil grey aur hawa se bhare lungs kaale dikhte hain; fracture safaid haddi par ek kaali line ki tarah dikhta hai kyunke X-rays darar (gap) mein se guzar jati hain. Jahan do soft tissues taqreeban barabar jazb karein, wahan contrast medium jaise barium (Z = 56, maide aur aanton ke liye barium meal) ya iodine (Z = 53, khoon ki naaliyon ke liye) diya jata hai taa ke jazb zyada ho aur woh numayan ho jayein.

blocks.prompt:
20.4 Compare CT and conventional X-ray imaging with respect to image clarity and diagnostic value.
Image ki saafi (clarity) aur tashkhees ki ahmiyat (diagnostic value) ke lihaz se CT aur aam X-ray imaging ka muwazna karein.
blocks.explanation: CT scan kahin zyada saaf aur tafseeli tasweer deta hai aur tashkhees (diagnosis) ke liye kahin zyada mufeed hai, magar is mein radiation, waqt aur kharcha zyada hai; aam X-ray jaldi aur aasan hai aur bohat se kaamon (jaise fracture) ke liye kaafi hai.

rows: Saafi: cross-sectional slices jor kar 3D image
Saafi: sirf ek flat 2D tasweer
Organs ek doosre par nahin aate; har ek apni jagah dikhta hai
Organs ek doosre par aa jate hain (maslan aagay peechay ki pasliyan)
Mili julti density wale tissues mein bhi farq dikhata hai
Mili julti density wale soft tissues mein contrast kam
Organs aur tumour ka size, shakal aur sahi jagah dikhata hai
Ek hi view mein sirf cheezon ka khaka (outline)
Tashkhees: tumour, andaroni chot aur khoon behna, stroke minton mein; ilaaj mein rehnumai (maslan tumour par radiation ka nishana)
Tashkhees: zyada tar haddiyan (fracture), chest aur daant; jaldi pehla muaina
X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai; computer tasweer banata hai
Film ya detector par ek exposure; computer ki zaroorat nahin
Radiation zyada; mehngi aur mushkil machine; hamila khawateen ke liye ehtiyaat
Radiation kam; saada, sasta aur jaldi

blocks.prompt:
20.5 Define tomography and explain how CT scanning creates 3D images using 2D slices.
Tomography ki tareef karein aur wazahat karein ke CT scanning 2D slices se 3D images kaise banati hai.
blocks.explanation:
Tomography: jism ki tasweer hissa ba hissa banana, yani jism ke ek patle slice (cross-section) ki tasweer banana. Yeh lafz Greek "tomos" (slice, tukra) se hai.
CT 3D image kaise banata hai (Computed Axial Tomography):
1. Mareez X-ray detectors ki ek ring ke andar couch par letta hai; X-ray tube ring par active detectors ke saamne hoti hai.
2. X-ray tube mareez ke gird ghoomti hai aur jism ke ek slice mein se bohat se mukhtalif zaviyon se patli beam guzarti hai. Har zaviye par saamne ke detectors naapte hain ke beam kitni kamzor (attenuate) hui.
3. Computer in tamam views ko jor kar hisaab lagata hai ke slice ka har chhota hissa kitna jazb karta hai. Is se us slice ki tafseeli 2D cross-sectional tasweer banti hai jis mein koi cheez doosri par nahin aati.
4. Phir couch mareez ko jism ke axis ke saath thora aagay khiskata hai aur agle slice ke liye yehi amal hota hai. Chand seconds mein saikron slices liye jate hain.
5. Computer in tamam 2D slices ko cake ki tehon (layers) ki tarah ek ke oopar ek rakh kar andaroni banawat ki 3D image banata hai, jo organs, haddiyon aur tumour ka size, shakal aur sahi jagah dikhati hai.
(CT scanner Godfrey Hounsfield aur Allan Cormack ne 1970s ke shuru mein banaya; 1979 mein Nobel Prize.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Ek double roti (bread) socho: har slice alag kaat kar dekho to andar ki har cheez saaf nazar aati hai. CT bhi jism ke patle patle slices ki tasweerein leta hai, phir computer saare slices wapas jor kar poori roti (3D image) bana deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.6 How would you explain the inner shell transitions of X-rays? Also explain characteristic and continues X-rays.
X-rays ki inner shell transitions ki wazahat kaise karenge? Characteristic aur continuous X-rays bhi bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Inner shell transitions:
1. Heavy atoms mein electrons K, L, M, N, ... shells mein hote hain; K-shell nucleus ke sab se qareeb hai. Andar wale electrons mazbooti se bandhe hote hain, is liye andar ki shells ke darmiyan energy ka farq bara hota hai.
2. X-ray tube mein garam cathode se nikalne wale electrons potential difference V se tez kiye jate hain aur heavy target (maslan tungsten) se (K.E.)ₘₐₓ = Ve ke saath takrate hain.
3. Tez electron K-shell ka ek electron nikaal sakta hai aur wahan khali jagah (hole) reh jati hai.
4. L-shell ka electron is hole mein kood kar photon hf(Kα) = E_L − E_K nikalta hai (Kα X-ray). Agar M-shell ka electron bhare to hf(Kβ) = E_M − E_K (Kβ X-ray), waghera. L aur M shells mein bachne wale holes oopar ki shells se bharte hain aur mazeed X-rays nikalti hain.
5. Kyunke yeh energy farq bare hain, photons X-rays hote hain.
Characteristic X-rays: in inner-shell transitions mein nikalne wale photons. In ki wavelengths muqarrar hoti hain jo target ke material par munhasir hain, aur yeh continuous spectrum par tez lines (peaks) ki tarah nazar aati hain. In ke mutale se atom ki banawat aur periodic table samajhne mein madad mili.
Continuous X-rays (bremsstrahlung, braking radiation yani rukne ki radiation): jab tez electrons target se takrate hain to achanak ruk jate (decelerate hote) hain. Accelerate (ya decelerate) hone wala charge electromagnetic radiation nikalta hai; yahan deceleration bohat zyada hai is liye radiation X-ray region mein hoti hai. Jo electron ek hi takkar mein apni saari kinetic energy kho de, woh sab se zyada energy ka photon deta hai: Ve = hfₘₐₓ = hc/λₘᵢₙ. Baqi electrons kai takkaron mein energy khote hain aur kam energy (lambi wavelength) ke photons dete hain, is liye λₘᵢₙ se oopar wavelengths ki ek musalsal (continuous) range banti hai. Characteristic lines isi continuous spectrum par nazar aati hain (Fig. 20.6).

rows: Andar ki shells ke electron transitions se (maslan L → K)
Tez electrons ke achanak rukne se (bremsstrahlung)
Muqarrar wavelengths: tez lines
λₘᵢₙ se oopar tamam wavelengths: continuous spectrum
Wavelengths target ke material par munhasir
λₘᵢₙ = hc/(Ve) voltage par munhasir, target par nahin

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "continues X-rays" chhapa hai; sahi lafz "continuous X-rays" (musalsal X-rays) hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.1 An electron jumps from a level Eᵢ = −3.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ J to E_f = −1.20 × 10⁻¹⁸ J. What is the wavelength of the emitted light? (Ans: 234 nm)
Ek electron Eᵢ = −3.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ J level se E_f = −1.20 × 10⁻¹⁸ J level par koodta hai. Kharij hone wali light ka wavelength kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: Eᵢ = −3.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, E_f = −1.20 × 10⁻¹⁸ J = −12.0 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
Maloom karna: λ
Kharij hone wale photon ki energy: hf = Eᵢ − E_f
ΔE = −3.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ J − (−12.0 × 10⁻¹⁹ J)
ΔE = 8.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ J
hc/λ = ΔE, is liye λ = hc/ΔE
λ = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(8.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ J)
λ = (1.989 × 10⁻²⁵ J m)/(8.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ J)
λ = 2.34 × 10⁻⁷ m = 234 nm
Jawab: λ = 234 nm (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Electron oonchi energy (−3.5 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, kam manfi) se neechi energy (−12.0 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, zyada manfi) par aaya, is liye energy ka farq photon ban kar nikla. Manfi numbers ka farq lete waqt sign ka khayal rakhein: −3.5 − (−12.0) = +8.5.

blocks.prompt:
20.2 Electrons in an X-ray tube are accelerated through a potential difference of 3000 V. If these electrons were slowed down in a target, what will be the minimum wavelength of X-rays produced? (Ans: 4.14 × 10⁻¹⁰ m)
X-ray tube mein electrons 3000 V potential difference se tez kiye jate hain. Agar yeh electrons target mein roke jayein to paida hone wali X-rays ka kam se kam wavelength kya hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: V = 3000 V, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
Maloom karna: λₘᵢₙ
Sab se chhota wavelength tab banta hai jab electron ek hi takkar mein apni saari kinetic energy kho de:
(K.E.)ₘₐₓ = Ve = hfₘₐₓ = hc/λₘᵢₙ
λₘᵢₙ = hc/(Ve)
Ve = 3000 V × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 4.8 × 10⁻¹⁶ J
λₘᵢₙ = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(4.8 × 10⁻¹⁶ J)
λₘᵢₙ = (1.989 × 10⁻²⁵ J m)/(4.8 × 10⁻¹⁶ J)
λₘᵢₙ = 4.14 × 10⁻¹⁰ m
Jawab: λₘᵢₙ = 4.14 × 10⁻¹⁰ m (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.prompt:
20.3 The wavelength of K X-ray from copper is 1.377 × 10⁻¹⁰ m. What is the energy difference between the two levels from which this transition results? (Ans: 9.03 KeV)
Copper ki K X-ray ka wavelength 1.377 × 10⁻¹⁰ m hai. Un do levels ke darmiyan energy ka farq kya hai jin ke darmiyan yeh transition hoti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: λ = 1.377 × 10⁻¹⁰ m, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J
Maloom karna: ΔE
Levels ki energy ka farq photon ki energy ke barabar hai:
ΔE = hf = hc/λ
ΔE = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(1.377 × 10⁻¹⁰ m)
ΔE = (1.989 × 10⁻²⁵ J m)/(1.377 × 10⁻¹⁰ m)
ΔE = 1.44 × 10⁻¹⁵ J
Electron volts mein: ΔE = (1.444 × 10⁻¹⁵ J)/(1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J eV⁻¹) = 9.03 × 10³ eV
ΔE = 9.03 keV
Jawab: ΔE = 1.44 × 10⁻¹⁵ J = 9.03 keV (kitab se milta hai).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke jawab mein unit "KeV" chhapi hai; sahi symbol keV hai (kilo-electron volt, chhota k). Qeemat 9.03 keV sahi hai.

blocks.prompt:
20.4 A tungsten target is struck by electrons that have been accelerated from rest through 40 kV potential difference. Find the shortest wavelength of the bremsstrahlung radiation emitted. (Ans: 0.31 × 10⁻¹⁰ m)
Tungsten target par woh electrons takrate hain jo sukoon (rest) se 40 kV potential difference se tez kiye gaye. Kharij hone wali bremsstrahlung radiation ka sab se chhota wavelength maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: V = 40 kV = 4.0 × 10⁴ V, e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
Maloom karna: λₘᵢₙ
Sab se chhota wavelength tab nikalta hai jab electron apni saari kinetic energy Ve ek hi photon ko de de:
Ve = hfₘₐₓ = hc/λₘᵢₙ
λₘᵢₙ = hc/(Ve)
Ve = 4.0 × 10⁴ V × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = 6.4 × 10⁻¹⁵ J
λₘᵢₙ = (6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s × 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)/(6.4 × 10⁻¹⁵ J)
λₘᵢₙ = (1.989 × 10⁻²⁵ J m)/(6.4 × 10⁻¹⁵ J)
λₘᵢₙ = 3.1 × 10⁻¹¹ m = 0.31 × 10⁻¹⁰ m
Jawab: λₘᵢₙ = 0.31 × 10⁻¹⁰ m (kitab se milta hai). Yeh target ke tungsten hone par munhasir nahin.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: λₘᵢₙ sirf voltage par munhasir hai: voltage double karo to λₘᵢₙ aadha. 3000 V par 4.14 × 10⁻¹⁰ m tha (Numerical 20.2), 40 kV par 0.31 × 10⁻¹⁰ m hai. Zyada voltage = zyada energy = chhota wavelength (hard X-rays).
